title: workflow concurrency placement: the concurrency block sits between on: and defaults: at top level in each .github/workflows file
answers: Where in a workflow YAML file should the concurrency key go?
How do I add a no-op concurrency block to a workflow that is missing one?
Which fields does the no-op run-scoped concurrency block use?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/*.yml top-level keys. The block is added by the same change set that added the policy rule; the 29 files that gained it all place it after `on:` and before `defaults:` (or before `env:`/`permissions:` where those exist).
Rule: To satisfy the policy, add a top-level block with exactly `group: ${{ github.run_id }}` and `cancel-in-progress: false`. This is the no-op form used by the PR; it does not change run behavior, it only satisfies the declaration requirement. Use a real group expression instead when the workflow needs superseding or serialization.
Symptom: (omitted for a howto.)
Constraints: The no-op form is a placeholder; do not copy it into workflows where stale-run cancellation or serialization is intended. Workflows that already had a concurrency key before this change were not touched by the PR.
applies: Adding or editing top-level concurrency in workflow files under .github/workflows; not for composite actions.
says: Where should the concurrency block be positioned within our automated workflow configuration?
Add a placeholder concurrency setting to satisfy pipeline policy validation without cancelling runs.
Our continuous integration pipeline needs the minimal concurrency definition to pass policy checks.
How do we declare non-cancelling concurrency for automation workflows missing the required section?
search: Top-level concurrency in .github/workflows/*.yml must be placed after on: and before defaults:, env:, or permissions:. To satisfy the workflow policy without altering run behavior, add group: ${{ github.run_id }} with cancel-in-progress: false. This no-op placeholder applies when adding or editing top-level concurrency in workflow files, but does not apply to composite actions. Do not copy the placeholder form when superseding or serialization is intended, and workflows that already had concurrency were not touched.
